sessions.notes_text:
CONTACT SUMMARY & SESSION OVERVIEW
- Session Stage: First Session / Intake
- Summary: Completed phone consultation/intake with [Client], who was released from prison on 10/20/2026 and is currently residing at a halfway house. [Client] was engaged and cooperative and reports no emergency needs. Reviewed documents, license suspension, housing plans, work history, and justice history. [Client] was added to the program waitlist (approx. 18 people ahead; estimated wait of a couple months) and agreed to begin Reentry Navigation by phone in the meantime.

CASE PLAN ALIGNMENT
- Stability Tier: Stable
- Stated Goals Progress: [Client] identified three goals: (1) reinstate driver's license, (2) employment, (3) housing in his own apartment. Goals set this session; no progress yet. A case plan will be built around these goals.

BRIEFCASE & GATES 1-4 UPDATES
- Gate 1 (Vital IDs, Meds, Supervision): Has birth certificate and SS card. His only photo ID is a driver's license, which is currently suspended. He has no separate state ID. Takes no medications. Currently at a halfway house with a projected release of 12/29/2026, possibly earlier as good-time days are applied (per conversation with halfway house staff today). Three years of supervision will follow release.
- Gate 2 (Housing, Comms, Legal, Resume): Housing: currently at halfway house. Not interested in transitional or shared housing and wants his own apartment. Has family he can stay with as a fallback. DMV: license was suspended during incarceration after his fiancée had an uninsured accident in a vehicle registered in his name, and he is being held liable. To reinstate, he reports he must pay approx. $1,400 plus a $2,500 deposit (to go to the other party) and carry SR-22 insurance for 3 years. Child support: none. Resume: no Turn90 resume yet.
- Gate 3 (Health, Recovery, Banking): No limiting health conditions. Denies current drug or alcohol use and reports past marijuana use only in his youth. Reported selling drugs but not using them. Bank account not discussed.
- Gate 4 (Work Gear, Transit, Employment/Finance): Transit: currently walking. Recently purchased a car but it is not on site, and he is not driving it while his license is suspended. Employment/finance plan not yet started.

EMPLOYMENT, HOUSING & STABILITY UPDATES
- Education: GED.
- Work history: machine operator at Kawashima (Lugoff, SC),
sessions.next_conversation_topics: Follow up on Reentry Navigation goals and Briefcase Gate 1–4 items.
